payload.core_mechanism_summary: Reverse-order snake validation: for each letter, check if its bounding box forms a straight segment and all cells in it are not overwritten by earlier letters, using jump pointers to skip validated cells and achieve amortized O(1) per cell.
payload.rationale: The algorithm processes snakes from last to first, validating each as a row or column segment. Jump arrays (R, D) skip already processed cells, giving amortized constant time per cell. This amortized skipping aligns best with the given candidate subtypes, though not a classic sliding window.
